summary: Nautilus: bookmark a folder in the sidebar, then compress a chosen set of files into a named zip
prompt: Using the Files app (Nautilus, already open on ~/Documents): add ~/Projects/alpha to the sidebar's bookmarks, then compress report.pdf, notes.txt and budget.ods from ~/Documents into a single zip archive named handoff.zip in ~/Documents. Leave the original files where they are. Do it in Files.
